notes: FAccT unified sweep. Marginal generators only for now; torch backbones (decaf, decaf_ctgan, decaf_dpgan, decaf_dpctgan, decaf_diffusion, decaf_dpdiffusion) are added to 'methods' once their per-dataset epochs are tuned. 2026-10-10: added acspubcov_ca, acspubcov_tx, cdc_diabetes (marginal generators). 2026-10-10: added decaf_tabpfn (DECAF's causal generator with TabPFN-3.5 in context as every attribute's conditional; not private, so one run per cell with NULL epsilon; hand-drawn DAGs, same as the GAN/diffusion families). Its shards run under the sdg_tabpfn environment ('python') and only from a scheduler given --gpu ('gpu_only'). Settings are on every row's extra_params; held-out log-loss of its conditionals is in tabpfn_conditionals.csv. 2026-10-12: added hmda_ca, hmda_tx (HMDA 2018 mortgage applications, data/hmda.py; marginal generators and decaf_tabpfn) and adult, compas (appendix continuity; previously only in rf-2026-09-01 at eps=10). 2026-10-13: added the torch causal families on the hand-drawn DAGs (decaf, decaf_ctgan, decaf_diffusion; not private, one run per cell) so that every causal family has the hand graph, and their DP-SGD variants (decaf_dpgan, decaf_dpctgan, decaf_dpdiffusion; epsilon 1, 10, 1000). The hand graph is fixed and data-independent, so the DP variants' guarantee holds here; it would not on the discovered graphs of facct-fges-2026-10-13. Epochs: DECAF_SETTINGS / each method's SETTINGS, the ACS, CDC and HMDA datasets borrowing SNAKE's (untuned for the DP variants).
